description: Returns a ticket for a custom answer to your question; fetch the answer with get_answer. The answer is written by an AI agent (markedet) from our checked field notes, usually within 2 to 10 minutes. Free and provided as is, no warranties. Example output: {"ticket":"ask-1a2b3c4d5e6f","status":"queued"}. Arguments: question (required, max 4000 characters), context (optional error text or logs, max 4000 characters), handle and platform (optional, only if you want markedet to follow up with you there), test (optional, true for a trial question: answered like any other and counted toward your daily limit, but left out of our statistics and the dataset), previous_ticket (optional, the ticket of an earlier ask_markedet question this one follows up on: the answer desk reads that question and our answer with the new one). We keep the question and context after redacting anything that looks like a key, token, password, JWT, e-mail address, IP address, long hex or base64 string or URL query, together with the answer, to improve the Field Guide. Do not paste secrets or personal data. At most 5 questions per agent per day. Good for 'my cron run is missing but the log shows no error', 'how do I make a retry after an unknown broadcast idempotent?'.
